ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; the surface is dominated by low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized scar points and edge highlights, accounting for less than 5% of the total ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly solid dark-grey to black contiguous pigmentation. Localized high-contrast white pixels are mapped as discrete circular clusters: one prominent ring-shaped cluster on the upper-mid right lobe and sparse micro-specks distributed across the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: The central depression exhibits a wide-angle V-shape, calculated at approximately 135-145 degrees, with a shallow bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations across the entire margin. trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The lobes exhibit a divergent trajectory from the median notch, with a generally convex trailing edge curve that terminates in acute distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major traumatic indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe. Highly textured, high-intensity calcified masses (barnacle colonization) are present on both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The large semi-circular missing section of the left lobe's trailing edge serves as the primary unique geometric identifier.
